name: A Bloodstained Journal Page
summary: Commander Althea Ebonlocke has a torn, bloodstained journal page examined during the investigation into Stalvan Mistmantle. A few words remain legible, and she asks Clerk Daltry to compare the handwriting with the Town Registry.

sections.title: A Grim Piece of Evidence
sections.body: Commander Althea Ebonlocke watches over Darkshire and asks that the handwriting on a torn, bloodstained page be examined. Though thick blood covers it, a few words remain legible for Clerk Daltry to compare with the Town Registry.

sections.title: Handwriting and Guilt
sections.body: Clerk Daltry keeps the registry in Darkshire's Town Hall and knows local handwriting from years of archiving signatures. He compares the page with municipal records and confirms that Stalvan wrote it, leaving no doubt of the tutor's guilt.

faq.q: What is this bloodstained journal page?
faq.answer: It is a torn, bloodstained page examined during the investigation into Stalvan Mistmantle. Commander Althea Ebonlocke asks Clerk Daltry to check its handwriting.

faq.q: Who can confirm who wrote this page?
faq.answer: Clerk Daltry in Darkshire's Town Hall can confirm who wrote the page. He keeps the town registry and compares its script with old signatures to verify Stalvan's handwriting.

faq.q: Why does Althea Ebonlocke need this page examined?
faq.answer: Commander Althea Ebonlocke has watched Stalvan for some time and wants Clerk Daltry to compare the page with the Town Registry. She needs to learn whether both were written by the same hand.

faq.q: Where does this page lead in the investigation?
faq.answer: The page goes to Clerk Daltry in Darkshire, where he compares its handwriting with the registry. After his examination, the investigation continues with Commander Ebonlocke.

angles.text: For protectors of the realm, Darkshire's Night Watch examines this grim document as evidence in the investigation.
